name: Voxy Production Pack v1
purpose: Final asset basis for eDebatte UX overhaul. Character assets are exported as true-alpha PNG/WebP; exact brand typography is included as SVG overlays.
rules: VOG pin belongs on viewer-right side of Voxy whenever visible.
eDebatte should appear blue/gradient; use overlays/edebatte-gradient.svg for exact typography.
No fake checkerboard backgrounds in character assets.
Use Voxy as a decision guide, not decorative clutter.
Subtle Framer Motion only; respect reduced-motion.

usage.voxy-neutral: Default guide, neutral onboarding, standard explanation.
usage.voxy-thinking: AI optional, review, graph check, unresolved questions.
usage.voxy-check: Saved, confirmed, ready for review or publish.
usage.voxy-hint: Important hint, visibility choice, warning before public state.
usage.voxy-welcome: Start page, first visit, onboarding step one.
usage.voxy-presenting: Explaining choices or showing next step.
usage.voxy-mini-avatar: Small inline hints, chat/assistant bubble, mobile compact UI.
